blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Foz do Iguaçu.

On arrival, you will be met and taken to your hotel. The rest of the day is free to relax after your flight and get ready for your visit to the waterfalls.

blocks.text: Foz do Iguaçu: Iguazu Falls, Macuco Safari and Bird Park

provenance.rationale: Combines the Foz do Iguaçu destination with the named Iguazu Falls, Macuco Safari and Bird Park activities from the Word program.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, set out to explore the Brazilian side of Iguazu Falls. You will hear the constant roar of the water well before reaching the falls. Walkways and viewing platforms offer breathtaking views over the canyon, the rainforest and the many cascading waterfalls.

The Guarani people called this place “big water”. The Iguazu Falls comprise some 275 cascades. One of the most famous is the Devil’s Throat, where the water plunges with immense force into a narrow gorge. Mist and rainbows often rise above the falls.

Return to your hotel.

provenance.wordAbsenceReason: The approved English Word itinerary covers the waterfalls and Guarani name in a longer Day 5 paragraph, but not this shorter Russian-derived editorial narrative.
